actions.text: The top of the steps, two above the floor.
Geometry Tour. Walk east through one room per kind of geometry.
Floor and ceiling heights: steps up to a ledge (north-east), a sunken pool (south), a low alcove (north-west).
A low tunnel: the ceiling is only three steps high.
A vaulted hall, two levels tall. The ramp south of the east end climbs a full level to a balcony.
A ramp up to a landing, then stairs down.
A sunken grotto with a deeper pool. The stairs to the east climb a full level.
An iron grate. You can see down, but not pass.
The upper room. Its floor has a grate (north-west), a trapdoor (north-east, use the lever), a pit (east) and an open shaft (south).
The balcony. Its west end has a pit back down to the hall.
You've dropped into the room below. The ladder in the south-west corner leads back up.
A trapdoor drops open in the north-east corner.
